body:
Phase 1. Spec: docs/archive/specs/2026-09-17-expense-lists-design.md, "The
form" and "Screens".

- New-list dialog: Expenses in the kind picker; choosing it reveals the
  currency field, prefilled from the account default, suggestions + free text.
- List properties for expense lists: currency read-only; hide kind toggle,
  duplicate, delete. (Leave stays as today in phase 1.)
- Overview card: total spent, plus your balance when >1 participant.
- List screen: summary bar -> balances; expenses newest first sectioned by
  date; second line "paid by AL · for everyone"; no shopping apparatus.
- Expense form, full screen like Add item: title (focused), total with the
  list currency as label, date defaulting to today, paid-by and paid-for as
  member rows (selector, initials + email, amount grey while auto / normal
  when fixed, clear returns to auto), note. Both distribution sections hidden
  with one participant. Cancel / Add, or Save / Delete when editing.
- Balances screen.
- Strings in all nine locales, identical key counts.
- Robolectric tests: form defaults, rebalancing through the UI, the two
  invalid states, solo form, balances screen.
title: expenses: Android — create, list screen, expense form, balances
